deadline.value: Apply by December 10, 2026, 11:59 pm EST (domestic and international); Fall entry only.
deadline.quote: DECEMBER 10, 2026 11:59PM EST: Deadline for all applicants (Domestic & International) entering Fall 2027

gre_subject.value: The Mathematics GRE is optional but strongly recommended; if you can take only one GRE, take the subject test.
gre_subject.quote: Math GRE Subject Tests (optional, but strongly recommended)

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement is mentioned.

funding.value: All accepted PhD students (except a few employer-funded) are offered support, usually a TA with tuition and a stipend (about $33,000 in year one).
funding.quote: All of our accepted PhD students (except a few who are supported by employers) are offered support by the University, usually in the form of a Teaching Assistantship.

entry_route.value: Math admits for the PhD only; the pages do not say whether a master's is expected.

english_waiver.value: Math asks every international applicant for TOEFL/IELTS, even those the Graduate School would exempt.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL/IELTS/PTE (international graduate students): TOEFL/IELTS required even if eligible for waiver.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives only a handful of fee waivers; email a request by December 1, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: You can request a fee waiver by December 1, 2026 if you send us an email with the subject, Fee Waiver Request- Your Last Name. | We only give out a handful of fee waivers each year

notes: Applied Mathematics & Statistics, and Scientific Computation (AMSC) is a separate interdisciplinary PhD (deadline December 15, 2026). TA writing/speaking sub-scores below the exemption levels mean a required English course.
